implementation: Request-local missing-plan state reconstruction, not periodic/one-shot scheduling
conditions: Current session plan exists, nonempty, goal tool registered, latest exact success receipt absent from prepared surface
stateless_semantics: At most one snapshot per request; same state can be replayed until a latest receipt is visible; never appended to runner or durable transcript
runtime_scope: Compact candidate admission and live reload

verification.source_sync: rsync current source, excludes .git target node_modules .env .env.* private key files; no secrets needed
verification.clippy: cargo clippy --locked -p xharness-core -p xharness-host --all-targets -- -D warnings: exit 0
